Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

declare
 chk number;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code != 'MULTI' then
 select count(*) into chk
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = :ctrl_block.inter_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 if chk = 0 then
 show_error('1185');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 select count(*) into chk
 from valid_interdictions
 where (1 = don_common_pack.is_access_allowed_0or1(:banner.user_id,'INTER',:ctrl_block.inter_code) or
 1 = don_common_pack.is_access_allowed_0or1(:banner.user_id,'PROPR',:ctrl_block.inter_code) )
 and inter_code = :ctrl_block.inter_code 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 if chk = 0 then
 show_error('18033');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 select inter_desc into :ctrl_block.inter_desc
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code = :ctrl_block.inter_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and rownum <2;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

DECLARE

 --
 -- Begin DONOR_INTERDICTIONS detail declare section
 --

 SELECT 1 FROM DONOR_INTERDICTIONS 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :DON_CURSOR.DONOR_ID;
 --
 -- End DONOR_INTERDICTIONS detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin DONOR_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DONOR_INTERDICTIONS_cur; 
 FETCH DONOR_INTERDICTIONS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( DONOR_INTERDICTIONS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DONOR_INTERDICTIONS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DONOR_INTERDICTIONS_cur;
 --
 -- End DONOR_INTERDICTIONS detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*trigger by jairam to populate every rec of address for donor rec. International address change on 07-apr-2011*/

declare
 l_intl_addr_flag varchar2(1);
 v_addr_intl varchar2(100);
 v_flag varchar2(1);
 begin

 select nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N') into v_flag
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :don_cursor.donor_id;
 
 if v_flag <> 'Y' then
 
 select A.street_name||decode(A.suite_apt,null,null,', '||A.suite_apt)||decode(b.city,null,null,', '||b.city)||decode(b.state,null,null,', '||b.state)||decode(b.zip,null,null,', '||b.zip) ,
 A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE ),
 A.H_AREA_CODE,A.H_PHONE_NO, A.D_AREA_CODE,A.D_PHONE_NO,A.EXTENSION 
 , A.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO ,A.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO ,A.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT ,A.EMAIL, NVL(A.INTL_ADDR_FLAG,'N') 
 INTO :DONOR_ADDRESSES.STREET_NAME, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_ADDR,
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.H_AREA_CODE, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.H_PHONE_NO, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.D_AREA_CODE
 , :DONOR_ADDRESSES.D_PHONE_NO, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.EXTENSION,
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_H_PHONE, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_PHONE, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_EXT
 , :DONOR_ADDRESSES.EMAIL, l_intl_addr_flag
 from donor_ADDRESSES a, valid_city_state b 
 WHERE a.usps_id=b.usps_id
 AND A.DONOR_ID = :don_cursor.donor_id;
 else 
 
 select INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE ),
 INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO ,INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO ,INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT ,EMAIL, NVL(INTL_ADDR_FLAG,'N') 
 INTO :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_ADDR,:DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_H_PHONE, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_PHONE, :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_EXT
 , :DONOR_ADDRESSES.EMAIL, l_intl_addr_flag
 from donor_ADDRESSES 
 WHERE DONOR_ID = :don_cursor.donor_id;
 
 end if; 
 
 IF l_intl_addr_flag = 'N' then -- show only local address . i had to write this if statement bcoz for intl address usps_id will be 0 and above query will populate local address with city, state and zip value for usps_id. and also few forms might allow users to enter local address inspite of intl addres has values which is wrong. 
 
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_ADDR := NULL; 
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_H_PHONE:= NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_PHONE:= NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.INTL_W_EXT:= NULL;
 
 else -- else show only intl address
 
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.STREET_NAME := NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.H_AREA_CODE := NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.H_PHONE_NO := NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.D_AREA_CODE := NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.D_PHONE_NO := NULL;
 :DONOR_ADDRESSES.EXTENSION := NULL;
 
 end if;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then Null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_o (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 
 Execute_Query; 
 
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

 PROCEDURE generate_where_clause is /* for donor_interdictions */
 begin
 generate_from_to_clause;
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code = 'MULTI' then
 if :ctrl_block2.rg_operation = 'A' then
 if ft_str is not null then --
 q_hdr := ft_str||' and donor_id in '||:ctrl_block2.inter_str_and;

 if :ctrl_block2.rg_operation != 'A' or 
 :ctrl_block2.rg_operation is null then /* no termination date logic for AND operation */

 else

 end if;
 else
 -- q_hdr := q_hdr|| ' )';
 null; 
 end if;
 end if;
 --message(:ctrl_block2.inter_str_and);pause;
 --message(q_hdr);pause;
 end;

 check_package_failure;

 END IF;

 WHEN OTHERS THEN

 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
